description: IsUnicode clear, StringData with Windows-1252 high bytes, and a ConsoleFEDataBlock naming code page 1252
notes: The one place a .lnk states a code page numerically is the ConsoleFEDataBlock's CodePage field (MS-SHLLINK 2.5.2), and it is about console display rather than about StringData - so ShellLink::ansi_encoding() is a hint the caller may use, not an authority. NAME_STRING carries 0xDF, RELATIVE_PATH 0xFC, and COMMAND_LINE_ARGUMENTS the 0x93/0x94 curly quotes that are C1 controls in ISO-8859-1. Without the codepage feature every one of those bytes is U+FFFD.
